description: Audit a swap quote someone else gave you (aggregator, broker, bot) BEFORE signing. Returns fair / overpaying / too_good_to_be_true with the configured-venue book as evidence. Ask this before accepting ANY number you did not produce yourself. Costs $0.05 per call.

amountIn.description: RAW units of tokenIn, as in the offer

chainId.description: REQUIRED. 1 Ethereum, 42161 Arbitrum, 8453 Base. There is no default; omitting it returns 400 missing_chain.

quotedOut.description: RAW units of tokenOut you were OFFERED

tokenIn.description: Token you are selling (symbol or 0x address)

tokenOut.description: Token you would receive (symbol or 0x address)

venueClaimed.description: Optional: who gave you the offer

name: verify_quote_fairness
